summary: Bisect the tree-verify EXTRA non-determinism at B=4 (beyond native self-noise): GDN-scan vs TREE_ATTN vs scheduler/RNG. Is there a cheap deterministic fix, or diffuse? + verify native is really 53% non-det. CPU code analysis.

synthesis.native_floor_real: ARTIFACT (tight bar). VERIFIED from the probe files: native_bi/native_swe4_probe.json is seed=1313 and native_bi_noise/native_noise_swe4_probe.json is seed=2313, with byte-identical prompts (sha256 6d4c70...). The compare.json key is literally named native_bi_self_noise = native_bi_seed1313 vs native_bi_seed2313. So the "53% native floor" (137/256 no-BI, 139/256 BI) is a DIFFERENT-SEED sampling comparison, not native B=4 batch self-noise. The divergence structure proves it: native shares a deterministic ~11-token template prefix then first-diverges exactly at the first sampled position (pos 11/31/11; prompt3 byte-identical across seeds) = textbook temp-0.6 two-seed sampling, not scheduler/batch interleave. This also explains why VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT left positional flips ~unchanged (137->139, seed-dominated) but cut bag-TV 0.152->0.086 (the actual batch-order channel). No same-seed (1313 vs 1313) native repeat exists anywhere in output/ -> the genuine native floor was NEVER measured and is almost certainly TIGHTER than 53%. Seed-robust proxy = bag-TV ~0.086-0.11. NET: the within-self-noise bar used by the corruption gate is LOOSE on positional flips; the real bar is harder. The tree FAILS regardless (gate uses seed-robust bag-TV 0.1099 budget + outside-self-noise argmax): tree bag-TV 0.2335 > 0.1099, real-loss 0.4751, accept/event 2.10 vs 3.62, depth-collapse run=6. With the correct tighter floor it loses by more.
synthesis.cheap_fix_exists: NO cheap deterministic fix in the named kernels, because they are not the carrier. VERIFIED: (1) GDN tree-scan (fr10_gdn_tree_kernel.py) is order-deterministic by construction - the ONLY atomic (line 251) is a COUNT_INVOCATION-gated diagnostic invocation_counter (off in serving), grid=(num_vh, cdiv(dim_v,BV)) at line 547 has NO batch axis (one launch per sequence in a serial python loop, disjoint buffers), num_warps=8 fixed (line 582), all reductions intra-program over constexpr axes. (2) FA2 fork decode tree-bias call (fr13_patch_fa2_tree_bias.py:570) passes block_table (paged KV) which forces the single-split splitkv kernel, and seqlen_q=tree_len>1 fails the seqlenq_ngroups_swapped gate so the num_splits heuristic never runs -> num_splits stays 0/1 -> per-row reduction order is batch-composition-INDEPENDENT, no combine kernel. Audit A flagged that the decode call omits num_splits (true, unlike prefill line 537's num_splits=1 if VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT) but audit B's FA2/CUTLASS source analysis shows it is inert here. The B=1 2-ULP MMA floor (max 0.0039, ~2 ULP/1M, no depth growth) does NOT scale with co-residency and cannot produce 189/256 (74%) divergence (~190x the floor). The REAL carrier is DIFFUSE and not in a kernel: it is the accept-pattern-dependent STATE/BANK-ROW selection that feeds the deterministic kernels (GDN h0 via h0_column=num_accepted-1, kernel lines 261-267; conv prior-window read clamp(accepted_lens-1).gather at fr10_phase4_patch_vllm_tree_gdn.py:~813-818), amplified through the spec-decode feedback loop. The corruption gate proves contamination not sampler-flip: 36.6% ROOT rejects where tree has the SAME single candidate as native (tree target_argmax != draft0), depth-collapse run, accept/event drop 2.10 vs 3.62 = multi-spine/state-handoff signature.
synthesis.fix_scope: No single-kernel fixed-reduction fix resolves it - the carrier is wiring/state-handoff, not kernel arithmetic. Concrete diagnosis targets (NOT a cheap deterministic fix, an investigation continuation per the conv-priorwindow-root memo): (1) conv prior-window READ + state-remap convention in scripts/fr10_phase4_patch_vllm_tree_gdn.py ~lines 797-818 (_fr10_conv_read_cols = clamp(accepted_lens-1); spec_state_indices_tensor.gather; index_select into conv_state) - the bank-row selected depends on the (temp0.6 non-deterministic) prior accept pattern and the conv1d_out row diverged to 18.375 at call2 in the root memo; failing row WANDERS between runs = the contamination signature. (2) GDN h0 bank read fr10_gdn_tree_kernel.py:261-267 (same num_accepted-1 keying). Cost: this is the FR13 conv-priorwindow-root front, already partially localized; it is a determinism-amplification through the feedback loop, NOT a localized seam with a byte-exact one-kernel fix. Cheapest decisive NEXT measurement (to set the real bar and isolate tree-extra non-det, ~2 boots): a SAME-seed (1313 vs 1313) native B=4 repeat AND a same-seed/same-config (max_tokens=64, spp=1) TREE repeat - the existing 189/256 tree pair conflates same-seed non-det with a max_tokens 128->64 / spp 4->1 batch-shape change, so it overstates pure run-to-run tree non-det.
synthesis.honest_verdict: The tree-verify's EXTRA B=4 non-determinism is DIFFUSE, not a cheap single-kernel seam, and the framing's "native 53% floor" is a measurement artifact that makes the real bar HARDER, not easier - both push toward STOP on the current cost-gate. Three independent audits converge: the two named kernels (GDN tree-scan, FA2 tree-bias fork) are deterministic by construction (no payload atomics, no batch axis, single-split paged reduction, fixed warp order - all source-verified) and cannot produce 189/256 token divergence; the B=1 ~2-ULP MMA floor does not scale with co-residency. The carrier is the accept-pattern-dependent state/bank-row selection (conv prior-window read at fr10_phase4 ~797-818 keyed on clamp(num_accepted-1); GDN h0 bank at kernel 261-267) amplified through the spec-decode feedback loop - the same determinism-amplification class FR11 already banked as a diffuse no-go, with no byte-exact fix consistent with the no-copy/no-reroute policy. The corruption gate FAILS hard and on the RIGHT (seed-robust) metrics: bag-TV 0.2335 > 0.1099, real-loss 0.4751 outside self-noise, accept/event 2.10 vs 3.62, depth-collapse, and 36.6% root rejects where tree==native single candidate (= verify contamination, conclusively not sampler-flip). CAVEATS for the user: (a) no live GPU re-run was done here - kernel determinism is a strong source-level argument, not an empirical fixed-input repeat-launch; (b) the genuine same-seed native floor was never measured (bag-TV 0.086-0.11 is the only seed-robust proxy) - one cheap same-seed native+tree repeat pair would pin the bar and de-conflate the 189/256 from its batch-shape change before any STOP is final. RECONSIDER-BAR is the honest secondary option ONLY to run those two same-seed probes; the engineering verdict is diffuse-expensive-stop.

the SYN lists 'a same-seed/same-config (64/1) TREE repeat' as a needed next measurement but MISSED that a clean same-config (64/1) same-seed (1313) CUDA-captured native-vs-tree comparison ALREADY EXISTS in the same artifact dir = 165/256 (64.5%) divergence with NO 128->64/spp4->1 confound. Half the proposed next measurement is already on disk and strengthens the FAIL beyond the confounded 189/256.

the positional 'loose bar' argument is directionally right but largely decorative: the tree FAILS on the seed-robust bag-TV bar (0.2335 > 0.1099) and real-loss (0.4751) regardless of where the positional floor sits, so 'the real bar is harder' carries little of the STOP verdict it is invoked to support.

(1) CARRIER backed by code: fr10_gdn_tree_kernel.py is deterministic by construction -- only atomic is COUNT_INVOCATION-gated invocation_counter (lines 250-256, off in serving), h0 bank keys on num_accepted-1 (261-267), scan is static_range tl.sum/tl.where over constexpr axes (277-343), deployed grid line 547 (num_vh, cdiv(dim_v,BV)) has NO batch axis, num_warps=8 fixed (582). The named kernels are NOT the carrier; the real carrier is accept-pattern-dependent state/bank-row selection (conv prior-window clamp(num_accepted-1) at fr10_phase4_patch_vllm_tree_gdn.py ~797-818; GDN h0 bank 261-267) amplified through the spec-decode feedback loop -- the same diffuse class FR11 banked as no-go, no byte-exact policy-compliant fix. (2) NATIVE_FLOOR_REAL backed by the actual config in the compare JSON: native_bi probe seed=1313 and native_bi_noise probe seed=2313, both temp0.6/top_p0.95/naive_mtp/B4/64-tok with byte-identical prompts; compare key is literally native_bi_self_noise = seed1313 vs seed2313 -> the '53% floor' is a different-seed sampling artifact, NOT batch self-noise (BI left positional flips 137->139 but cut bag-TV 0.152->0.086). Seed-robust floor ~0.086-0.11 bag-TV; same-seed same-regime native self-repeat never run. (3) COST_GATE honestly distinguishes: corruption gate FAILS on the right seed-robust metrics -- bag-TV 0.2335 > 0.1099, real-loss 0.4751 (105 losses outside self-noise), depth-collapse run_len 6, accept/event 2.10 vs native 3.619, root-reject 36.6% (201/549, same-single-candidate = verify contamination not sampler-flip), passed=False. NEW SUPPORTING EVIDENCE the SYN missed: a clean same-config (64/1) same-seed (1313) CUDA-captured native-vs-tree comparison already on disk = 165/256 = 64.5% divergence, confound-free. RESIDUAL CAVEATS: (a) no live GPU re-run -- kernel determinism and FA2 'inert num_splits' are source-level arguments, not repeat-launch measurements; (b) the one genuinely-missing probe is a same-seed (1313 vs 1313) same-regime native self-repeat to pin the exact floor, but the verdict already holds on the seed-robust bar.
verify.decisive_test: One paired same-seed (1313 vs 1313), same-config (max_tokens=64, spp=1), same-regime (CUDA-captured, B=4) NATIVE self-repeat (~2 boots) to pin the genuine native floor (positional + bag-TV). The clean same-config same-seed native-vs-tree pair the SYN also proposed is ALREADY on disk (output/fr13_b4_nondet_bi_native_20260609T220457Z: native_bi vs tree_repeat = 165/256, 64.5%), so only the native self-repeat is missing. If that native self-repeat shows positional flips << 53% and bag-TV <= ~0.06 (as the seed-robust proxy predicts), the tree's 64.5% divergence and bag-TV 0.2335 are outside the real floor by an even wider margin -> STOP is final.
